 25   def thread_first(val, *forms):
 26       """ Thread value through a sequence of functions/forms
 27
 28       >>> def double(x): return 2*x
 29       >>> def inc(x):    return x + 1
 30       >>> thread_first(1, inc, double)
 31       4
 32
 33       If the function expects more than one input you can specify those inputs
 34       in a tuple.  The value is used as the first input.
 35
 36       >>> def add(x, y): return x + y
 37       >>> def pow(x, y): return x**y
 38       >>> thread_first(1, (add, 4), (pow, 2))  # pow(add(1, 4), 2)
 39       25
 40
 41       So in general
 42           thread_first(x, f, (g, y, z))
 43       expands to
 44           g(f(x), y, z)
 45
 46       See Also:
 47           thread_last
 48       """
 49       def evalform_front(val, form):
 50           if callable(form):
 51               return form(val)
 52           if isinstance(form, tuple):
 53               func, args = form[0], form[1:]
 54               args = (val,) + args
 55               return func(*args)
 56       return reduce(evalform_front, forms, val)

 59   def thread_last(val, *forms):
 60       """ Thread value through a sequence of functions/forms
 61
 62       >>> def double(x): return 2*x
 63       >>> def inc(x):    return x + 1
 64       >>> thread_last(1, inc, double)
 65       4
 66
 67       If the function expects more than one input you can specify those inputs
 68       in a tuple.  The value is used as the last input.
 69
 70       >>> def add(x, y): return x + y
 71       >>> def pow(x, y): return x**y
 72       >>> thread_last(1, (add, 4), (pow, 2))  # pow(2, add(4, 1))
 73       32
 74
 75       So in general
 76           thread_last(x, f, (g, y, z))
 77       expands to
 78           g(y, z, f(x))
 79
 80       >>> def iseven(x):
 81       ...     return x % 2 == 0
 82       >>> list(thread_last([1, 2, 3], (map, inc), (filter, iseven)))
 83       [2, 4]
 84
 85       See Also:
 86           thread_first
 87       """
 88       def evalform_back(val, form):
 89           if callable(form):
 90               return form(val)
 91           if isinstance(form, tuple):
 92               func, args = form[0], form[1:]
 93               args = args + (val,)
 94               return func(*args)
 95       return reduce(evalform_back, forms, val)

 98   def instanceproperty(fget=None, fset=None, fdel=None, doc=None, classval=None):
 99       """ Like @property, but returns ``classval`` when used as a class attribute
100
101       >>> class MyClass(object):
102       ...     '''The class docstring'''
103       ...     @instanceproperty(classval=__doc__)
104       ...     def __doc__(self):
105       ...         return 'An object docstring'
106       ...     @instanceproperty
107       ...     def val(self):
108       ...         return 42
109       ...
110       >>> MyClass.__doc__
111       'The class docstring'
112       >>> MyClass.val is None
113       True
114       >>> obj = MyClass()
115       >>> obj.__doc__
116       'An object docstring'
117       >>> obj.val
118       42
119       """
120       if fget is None:
121           return partial(instanceproperty, fset=fset, fdel=fdel, doc=doc,
122                          classval=classval)
123       return InstanceProperty(fget=fget, fset=fset, fdel=fdel, doc=doc,
124                              classval=classval)

127   class InstanceProperty(property):
128       """ Like @property, but returns ``classval`` when used as a class attribute
129
130       Should not be used directly.  Use ``instanceproperty`` instead.
131       """
132       def __init__(self, fget=None, fset=None, fdel=None, doc=None,
133                            classval=None):
134           self.classval = classval
135           property.__init__(self, fget=fget, fset=fset, fdel=fdel, doc=doc)
136
137       def __get__(self, obj, type=None):
138           if obj is None:
139               return self.classval
140           return property.__get__(self, obj, type)
141
142       def __reduce__(self):
143           state = (self.fget, self.fdel, self.__doc__, self.classval)
144           return InstanceProperty, state
